description_for_human: Projets HERMES 5.1 : statut, météo, tâches, décisions du mandant et rapports de statut.
description_for_model: PROJECTOR is the HERMES 5.1 project management tool of the organisation. Use it to list projects and their health (weather green/orange/red), get project details, list tasks (the user's own tasks or a project's tasks), list decisions waiting for the user as sponsor (mandant), generate a textual status report, and perform actions on behalf of the user: complete or comment a task, approve or reject a phase gate, approve or reject a budget revision. Always resolve identifiers with listProjects, listMyTasks or listPendingDecisions before acting, never invent ids, and always ask the user to confirm before an action. Include the url field as a link when citing a project or task.

functions.name: getMe
functions.description: Returns the signed-in PROJECTOR user with counts of open tasks, overdue tasks and pending decisions.

functions.name: listProjects
functions.description: Lists the projects visible to the user with status, HERMES phase, progress, weather, project manager and sponsor. Supports text search (q), status and weather filters.

functions.name: getProject
functions.description: Returns the details of one project: health per dimension with reasons, task counts, overdue tasks, pending decisions and next milestones.

functions.name: listProjectTasks
functions.description: Lists the tasks of a project, optionally filtered by status (open, overdue, bloque…) or restricted to the user's tasks.

functions.name: getProjectStatusReport
functions.description: Generates the Markdown status report of a project (KPIs, weather, phases, overdue tasks, decisions).

functions.name: listMyTasks
functions.description: Lists the open tasks assigned to the signed-in user across all projects, sorted by due date.

functions.name: listPendingDecisions
functions.description: Lists phase gate validations and budget revisions waiting for the user's decision as project sponsor (mandant).

functions.name: completeTask
functions.description: Marks a task as done on behalf of the user.

confirmation.title: Terminer la tâche
confirmation.body: Marquer la tâche **{{function.parameters.taskId}}** comme terminée dans PROJECTOR ?

functions.name: commentTask
functions.description: Adds a comment to a task on behalf of the user.

confirmation.title: Commenter la tâche
confirmation.body: Ajouter ce commentaire à la tâche **{{function.parameters.taskId}}** : {{function.parameters.text}}

functions.name: approvePhaseGate
functions.description: Approves the pending phase gate of a project as sponsor; the project moves to the next HERMES phase.

confirmation.title: Valider la phase
confirmation.body: Valider, en tant que mandant, le passage de phase du projet **{{function.parameters.projectId}}** (signature : {{function.parameters.signatureText}}) ?

functions.name: rejectPhaseGate
functions.description: Rejects the pending phase gate of a project as sponsor, with a mandatory reason.

confirmation.title: Refuser la phase
confirmation.body: Refuser la validation de phase du projet **{{function.parameters.projectId}}** pour le motif : {{function.parameters.comment}} ?

functions.name: approveBudgetRevision
functions.description: Approves a pending budget revision as sponsor.

confirmation.title: Approuver la révision budgétaire
confirmation.body: Approuver, en tant que mandant, la révision budgétaire **{{function.parameters.revisionId}}** (signature : {{function.parameters.signatureText}}) ?

functions.name: rejectBudgetRevision
functions.description: Rejects a pending budget revision as sponsor, with a mandatory reason.

confirmation.title: Refuser la révision budgétaire
confirmation.body: Refuser la révision budgétaire **{{function.parameters.revisionId}}** pour le motif : {{function.parameters.comment}} ?
